name: Alvin Ah-Chok
transcript:
Albert (SDR): Hi Alvin, thanks for joining this call. Tell me about your TM1 setup.
Alvin Ah-Chok: We are running legacy TM1 on-premise, version 10.2. We run two instances: production and development. We have 4 models and 15 cubes.
Albert (SDR): And what about performance?
Alvin Ah-Chok: We haven't checked performance metrics in detail, but RAM is high. Our main sheets take over 10 seconds to load and log files are definitely over 50MB and not cleared.
Albert (SDR): Who manages the system?
Alvin Ah-Chok: Support is ad hoc... in-house resource drives the agenda with no clear development roadmap. We want to transition support as soon as possible.
Albert (SDR): Great. We'll set up a Flight Check and DevOps Blue support.

customQuestions.q: What ERP system is active? (QA Test Permanent Edit)
customQuestions.a: Legacy on-premise TM1 v10.2.2. "We are running legacy TM1 on-premise... version 10.2."

customQuestions.q: How many TM1 instances do you run (e.g., production-only, or separate dev and test environments)?
customQuestions.a: Two instances (Production and Development). "We run two instances."

customQuestions.q: How many models, cubes, dimensions, and user groups are you currently running?
customQuestions.a: 4 core planning models, 15 cubes, and approximately 30 dimensions. "We have 4 models and 15 cubes."

customQuestions.q: Have you checked your system's performance, RAM usage, hard disk space, or feeder memory usage? Are they approaching high limits?
customQuestions.a: No recent audit, RAM usage is close to hardware limits. "We haven't checked performance metrics in detail, but RAM is high."

customQuestions.q: Are log files being automatically cleared, and what is the typical size of your TM1 log files (e.g., is it under or over the 50MB standard)?
customQuestions.a: Not automatically cleared; log files regularly exceed 100MB. "Our log files are definitely over 50MB and not cleared."

customQuestions.q: What are the typical report load times for your end-users, and are they above the 5-second threshold (e.g. 15-25 seconds)?
customQuestions.a: Complex reports take 12 to 15 seconds to load, exceeding the threshold. "Our main sheets take over 10 seconds to load."

customQuestions.q: Do you have dedicated in-house TM1 administrators/developers, or are you dependent on key individuals?
customQuestions.a: No dedicated administrator; the system is managed ad-hoc by a finance analyst. "Support is ad hoc... in-house resource drives the agenda."

customQuestions.q: Are you currently working with another TM1 vendor? Are you locked into a rigid contract with separate rates for support and development?
customQuestions.a: No, currently on ad-hoc support billing. "No contract, just ad-hoc billing."

customQuestions.q: What is your current backlog of enhancements, bugs, or data reconciliation tasks, and how is it prioritized?
customQuestions.a: Significant backlog of over 12 outstanding planning enhancements. "We have a growing backlog of enhancement projects."

customQuestions.q: Have your TM1 developers and power users had formal training, and would they benefit from free access to professional training courses?
customQuestions.a: Yes, very interested in standard training library access. "Yes, training would be extremely useful."

customQuestions.q: Are you using Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik, and do you have a direct database connection or are you manually handling CSVs?
customQuestions.a: Yes, Power BI is connected via manual CSV exports. "We use Power BI via manual CSVs."

customQuestions.q: Who has final authority to approve support changes, and what is the timeline to transition support (e.g. target date like October 31)?
customQuestions.a: Immediate transition requested, well ahead of the October target. "We want to transition support as soon as possible."

customQuestions.q: Where is the target deployment? (QA Test Add Q)

QUALIFICATION SCORE: HOT

SCORING RATIONALE: The prospect has clear operational pain (ad-hoc support, backlog of enhancements, and performance bottlenecks), high key-person risk with no dedicated administrator, and is ready for immediate transition.

RECOMMENDED NEXT STEP: Propose a TM1 Flight Check to audit the legacy environment and transition them to DevOps Blue support.

content.migrationReport:
CURRENT STATE

Shift runs legacy on-premise TM1 v10.2.2 across two instances. The environment suffers from high RAM usage, unrotated log files (>100MB), and slow report loading times (10-15 seconds).

GAPS IDENTIFIED

Key-person risk due to lack of a dedicated administrator. Growing backlog of planning enhancements and Excel-based Power BI exports.

RECOMMENDED MIGRATION PATH

Execute an **Octane TM1 Flight Check** to audit model efficiency, clear memory logs, and standardize cubes. Transition Shift to **DevOps Blue Support** for ongoing administration and roadmap delivery.

ESTIMATED COMPLEXITY

Complexity: Medium. Requires upgrading from v10.2.2 to the cloud-based Planning Analytics platform and restructuring memory allocations.

DEPENDENCIES

Verify network configurations and sandbox server availability for migration testing.

content.proposal:
1. UNDERSTANDING OF REQUIREMENTS

Shift requires transition of their legacy TM1 v10.2.2 support to a structured DevOps model to resolve system performance bottlenecks and handle enhancement backlogs.

2. PROPOSED SOLUTION

We propose a **TM1 Flight Check** audit followed by **Octane Blue Support**.

  • TM1 Flight Check: Fixed A$5,800. A 6-day complete analysis of system health (RAM, disk, log file rotation, model efficiency).
  • DevOps Blue Support: A$4,560/month base support. Inclusions: Rollover hours, monthly health checks, free professional training library.

3. APPROACH & METHODOLOGY

We recommend a 6-day Flight Check audit followed by support onboarding.

4. TEAM & RESOURCES

A Lead Architect (Amendra Pratap) will conduct the audit, supported by our developer team for ongoing support.

5. NEXT STEPS

Book a Positional Meeting with Amendra to schedule the Flight Check kickoff and confirm server access.
